LESSON: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS ISTISQAA ISTIKHARA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do Muslims perform prayers on special occasions?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PRAYERS ON SPECIAL OCCASIONS ISTISQAA ISTIKHARA
This lesson teaches Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara for Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara above.
2. Explain Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do Muslims perform prayers on special occasions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings
2. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way
